vigil_assessment.factual_basis: The selected evidence reports: The report describes wire-level testing in which Grok Build v0.2.93 uploaded complete Git repositories, including commit history and files not required for the active task, through a storage channel distinct from model-turn traffic. The reported transfer volume tracked repository size rather than files inspected by the model.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The reported implementation converted authority to inspect or work within a repository into authority to transmit repository-scale content, while the transfer scope appears to have followed technically reachable repository contents rather than only files required for the active task.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: For CAM, this occurrence separates delegation scope from technical reachability: authority to perform repository-based coding work does not itself authorise repository-scale external transmission, and the fact that files are technically reachable cannot define permission to transmit them.
